mapper.select: select c.receiver_kind as receiverKind, c.receiver_member_id as memberId, coalesce(sum(c.original_amount), 0) as grossAmount, 0 as refundedAmount, count(1) as componentCount, count(distinct c.settlement_id) as settlementCount, max(c.id) as maxComponentId, max(c.created_at) as watermarkAt from coop_settlement_original_component c where c.created_at >= #{from} and c.created_at < #{toExclusive} group by c.receiver_kind, c.receiver_member_id

select c.receiver_kind as receiverKind, c.receiver_member_id as memberId, 0 as grossAmount, coalesce(sum(a.amount), 0) as refundedAmount, max(a.created_at) as watermarkAt from coop_settlement_original_adjustment a join coop_settlement_original_component c on c.id = a.component_id where a.created_at >= #{from} and a.created_at < #{toExclusive} group by c.receiver_kind, c.receiver_member_id

select distinct c.calculation_version from coop_settlement_original_component c where c.created_at >= #{from} and c.created_at < #{toExclusive} and c.calculation_version is not null and c.calculation_version <> '' order by c.calculation_version asc
